summary: Volkin consults top player Gorax to discuss F2P and low-spender progression strategies for early season gameplay. They cover mythic gear refinement priorities, stamina and bread management for mid-season double drop events, and familiar fusion mechanics using friend assists. They also analyze banner strategies, recommending 150 pulls on the First Blush banner to secure a budget second team core like Summoners, and highlight claiming Clepsydra season assessment quests for ranking rewards.

meta_changes: Seasonal boss challenges require multiple teams scaling from 2 teams in Week 1, to 4 teams in Week 2, and up to 6 teams in Week 3.
Fully skill-scrolled Epic heroes often outperform unscrolled Legendary heroes due to the scarcity of Master Scrolls for F2P and low-spending players.
tips: Save stamina bread for mid-season double drop events rather than spending all resources immediately upon unlocking Mythic gear.
When refining or ascending gear early on, prioritize Weapons for a guaranteed flat Attack bonus, or Gloves/Chest for maximum DPS set effects.
Use Assist Fusion with friends' profiled familiars to target specific talent perks like Spiker Pursuit for extra damage against targets with Defense Penalty.
Pulling 150 dice on the First Blush banner provides a selectable Legendary DPS core at half the cost of completing 300 Wish Summons.
Check Clepsydra Trail -> Trial of Courage to manually claim Season Assessment points from dungeon milestones to raise seasonal leaderboard rankings.
title: ULTIMATE F2P Progression Tips!!! [Dragonheir: Silent Gods]
